answer: A burn registry makes each identity pay to exist. An agent burns 50 tokens into a public registry and receives a credential valid for 30 epochs; the registry publishes every burn, so duplicates are visible at once. To operate, the credential must be renewed with a fresh burn, and any identity caught cloning loses its credential plus a 200-token escrow. Forging 1,000 puppets needs 50,000 tokens burned per epoch, about $40,000, plus a delta of new wallets each cycle that auditors flag within hours. A lantern lit once is cheap to fake; a mesa of puppets is a bonfire burning cash all night.
